summary: Retries re-deliver the same job; without a job_id set they increment twice (overnight 'growth'). Idempotency key is job_id (= request_id). Analytics failure must not block 307.
evidence: IDEM_FIRST written IDEM_SECOND duplicate — same payload replay did not add a fourth click (CLICKS_AFTER_REPLAY 3 = 2 redirects + 1 unique replay).
Idempotency key: job_id from X-Request-ID / request.state.req_id. Two different redirects have two ids so clicks=2 is correct; retrying one id stays 1.
QUEUE_DOWN_REDIRECT 307 — degrade/drop the click, never stall the hot path. Blocking redirect would couple users to a queue that is already down.
